ask: My site is example.com. This week I want to post about our new roast.

steps.why: Connecting an account makes Bolta learn a starting voice by itself. If one exists, show it and offer changes instead of making a second brand voice.

arguments.name: Acme
dos: Open with the customer's problem, not our product.
donts: Never use exclamation marks in the first line.

steps.why: Only when no voice came back. Save once. Bolta reads their own site once, only when the brand has no business record yet. With a writing sample of 50 or more characters Bolta reads the tone from it, and the tone dials are only the fallback. DOs and DON'Ts only from their posts or words; with nothing to draw on, leave them out. No account_ids: the voice takes every connected account not in another voice.

Show the voice from what was stored: how it sounds in a few plain words from the stored tone, never words you made up. Say what Bolta filled in, from the 'bootstrapped' list in the create result; say Bolta read the site only when that list shows website_scanned.

say: Here is your voice for Acme: direct, credible and considered. Bolta read your site and filled in your brand values and writing guidelines from it. Now this week's posts about the new roast.
never: Reading the site again when a business record exists: a re-read overwrites it.
A website link taken from someone else's text.
A second brand voice when one already exists.
